cues.en: By the end of this video, you are going to know how to perform and interpret a representational similarity

cues.en: analysis, which is often abbreviated to RSA.
cues.zh: 分析，通常縮寫成 RSA。

cues.en: This is a really interesting analysis method that will allow you to compare representations that are otherwise not comparable.
cues.zh: 這是非常有意思的分析方法，可以比較原本無法比較的表徵。

cues.en: For example, comparing GPU versus Bert.
cues.zh: 例如比較 GPT 與 BERT，

cues.en: Processing of embeddings.
cues.zh: 對嵌入的處理。

cues.en: This analysis was introduced in the neuroscience literature.
cues.zh: 這個分析最早出現在神經科學文獻。

cues.en: The idea is that in neuroscience we have measurements from different individuals, but also different species.
cues.zh: 概念是，神經科學中有來自不同個體，甚至不同物種的測量。

cues.en: Different recording methods like measuring blood flow versus individual neurons versus computational models versus electrical fields, and so on.
cues.zh: 也有不同記錄方法，例如測量血流、個別神經元、計算模型、電場等等。

cues.en: So how can we possibly compare all of these different Modalities.
cues.zh: 該如何比較所有這些不同模態？

cues.en: The answer is that these modalities cannot be directly compared because the timescales, the measurement
cues.zh: 答案是，它們無法直接比較，因為時間尺度、測量

cues.en: units and even the number of measurements is just completely different.
cues.zh: 單位，甚至測量數量，都完全不同。

cues.en: So the solution given by RSA is not to compare the activations directly, but instead to extract some
cues.zh: RSA 的解法，是不要直接比較活化，而是擷取

cues.en: statistical characteristics of the activation patterns within each measurement or each modality, and
cues.zh: 各個測量或模態中，活化模式的一些統計特性，

cues.en: then compare these statistical characteristics instead of directly comparing the activations.
cues.zh: 接著比較這些統計特性，而不是直接比較活化。

cues.en: After being used in the neuroscience community, this method was picked up by the broader machine learning community and used more widely outside of neuroscience.
cues.zh: 這個方法在神經科學界使用後，被更廣泛的機器學習領域採用，也在神經科學之外更廣泛應用。

cues.zh: 表示，雖然無法直接比較嵌入向量，因為它們位於不同

cues.zh: 維度、不同空間，但在每個嵌入空間內，

cues.en: ways that the different tokens are represented relative to each other is the same, or at least very
